scripts.intended_objective: Approach stone 0, push it east, have teammate 1 brake it at (4,3), then redirect north and wait for bounded friction. This script does not claim a terminal score.

paired_intervention_hypotheses.intended_difference: Teammate 1 Brake versus Wait should keep stone 0 at (4,3) versus allow later endpoints (5,3),(6,3); compare stone_pos, momentum, velocity, braked and teammate energy.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.comparison_rule: Same reset key and identical prefix; compare named actual state leaves and legal masks after each suffix transition. No candidate outcome was supplied to the author.
